title.narrative: IOM:Responding to Immediate & Residual Post Crisi in Zimbabwe

description.narrative: Humanitarian assistance to irregular migrants, Third Country Nationals (TCN) and Internally Displaced People (IDP) and capacity building and assistance for long term IDP receiving communities to deliver 'durable solutions'

Humanitär hjälp till illegala invandrare, tredjelandsmedborgare (TCN) och internflyktingar (IDP) och kapacitetshöjande samt stöd till långsiktig IDP-mottagande samhällen för att leverera "hållbara lösningar".

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: 1.Humanitarian assistance to irregular migrants, Third Country Nationals (TCN) and Internally Displaced People (IDP); build Government capacity in the same and handover to governing authorities at the conclusion of first year of pragramming, while retaining backstopping capacity. 2. Capacity building and assistance for long term IDP receiving communities to permanently integrate IDPs and for highest migrant sending areas to on one hand, cope with these cross border movements and on the other achieve a certain level of socio-economic stability.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
